title: Beatrix and the Colony
author: Vesper Yarrow
blurb: Marguerite Okonkwo, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
